description: Impeccable design detector (PostToolUse on UI edits + Stop deep pass), task-observer SessionStart activation, and the UserPromptSubmit decision-recorder that stops an owner ruling being absorbed into the work without being written down, and the Stop backlog guard that fails a turn which destroyed a filed backlog record ([DOCS-GUARD]), and the PreToolUse background-command guard that refuses a backgrounded npm/npx command which never moves into raptor-port ([BG-CWD-GUARD], D162). And the compaction set-up ([COMPACT-WHEN-MOD], D868, D870, D871): autoCompactWindow lowers the app's own compaction to about 85% of a 1M chat; a PostToolUse reminder from 75% of the app's own room — the autoCompactWindow, which the app compacts at 96% of (compact-watch, D878), a PreCompact guard that holds an automatic compaction from 90% of that room to under 900,000 tokens until the agent marks ready (compact-guard), a SessionStart "compact" hook that hands back the chat's HANDOFF.md block (compact-resume), and the status line showing the fullness (statusline). Every one fails open.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/bg-cwd-guard.mjs" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/bg-cwd-guard.mjs"; else exit 0; fi
